Extra Ordinary
Ministry of Heavy Industries
Department of Heavy Industry
CSL

By a Resolution No. Eng.Ind.l7(17)/55, dated the 10th October, 1955 the Government of India asked the Tariff Commission to make an enquiry into the. prices of locomotives and boilers produced by M/s. Tata Locomotive and Engineering Co. Ltd
Extra Ordinary
Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution
Department of Consumer Affairs
CSL

It has been reported that a surcharge of 13 per cent has been levied on freight in respect of consignments shipped from U.K. and other Continental countries owing to the Suez Canal crisis as the shipments are being diverted via Cape of Good Hope. There is also a reported increase in the insurance charges.
